data.name: Noah
data.gender_notes: Noah is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Noaḥ, from the root n-w-ḥ, 'rest, comfort' (Genesis 5:29). Its root is Hebrew n-w-ḥ. Noah and the ark (Genesis 6-9). Noah is a Hebrew name meaning “Rest; comfort”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Noah expresses “Rest; comfort”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Noaḥ, from the root n-w-ḥ, 'rest, comfort' (Genesis 5:29).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noah total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
